title: fomc / fed funds / rate decision | Fomc Statement | Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
summary: The Federal Open Market Committee voted unanimously on January 27, 2021 to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 0 to 1/4 percent and to continue asset purchases at the pace of at least $80 billion per month in Treasuries and at least $40 billion per month in agency mortgage-backed securities. The Committee formalized its new average inflation targeting framework, committing to maintain an accommodative stance until inflation has risen to 2 percent and is on track to moderately exceed 2 percent for some time, alongside achieving maximum employment.
